fix_name: Fix Nearby Drivers Not Appearing in Dashboard
goal: Ensure nearby drivers appear correctly in the dashboard Nearby component using real-time socket updates and consistent geolocation logic.

agents.responsibility: Verify the current user's location is emitted correctly.

tasks.title: Verify browser geolocation
actions: Inspect dashboard/map page
Ensure navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition is called
Confirm latitude/longitude are valid numbers (not 0,0)
Add temporary console.log for emitted coords

tasks.title: Verify socket emission
actions: Ensure update_location is emitted after geolocation resolves
Ensure payload matches LocationUpdateSchema exactly
Ensure emission happens at least once on mount

definition_of_done: update_location emits with valid lat/lng from dashboard

agents.responsibility: Ensure driver locations are stored correctly on the server.

tasks.title: Inspect location.handler.ts
actions: Confirm setDriverLocation(userId, lat, lng, socketId) is called
Confirm socket.data.userId is used as key
Confirm updatedAt timestamp is set

tasks.title: Stale filtering audit
actions: Check stale cutoff logic (> 5 minutes)
Ensure updatedAt is compared using Date.now() consistently
Confirm units are milliseconds vs seconds

definition_of_done: In-memory store contains multiple active drivers

agents.responsibility: Fix distance filtering logic if it excludes valid drivers.

tasks.title: Audit Haversine usage
actions: Ensure lat/lng order is correct (lat, lon)
Ensure distance <= 50 km comparison
Add temporary logging of calculated distances

tasks.title: Ensure self is excluded
actions: Exclude current userId explicitly
Ensure this exclusion does not break array logic

definition_of_done: Nearby drivers array contains expected users within range

agents.responsibility: Ensure dashboard Nearby component receives and renders data.

tasks.title: Socket subscription audit
actions: Ensure useSocket subscribes to nearby_driver_update
Ensure listener is registered once
Ensure cleanup on unmount

tasks.title: State wiring
actions: Ensure dashboard Nearby component uses socket-driven state
Ensure state is not overridden by empty API fetch
Ensure map and dashboard share same nearbyDrivers source

definition_of_done: Dashboard updates immediately when socket event arrives

integration_verification: Open two browsers (User A and User B)
Server logs show both users in store
Dashboard Nearby component renders other driver
anti_regression_rules: Do not add polling to fix real-time issues
Do not duplicate nearby logic between map and dashboard
stop_condition: Nearby drivers appear reliably in dashboard and update in real time when drivers move.
